trickyParts: y-prosemirror 1.3.7 deletes an element its schema cannot build (sync-plugin.js createNodeFromYElement) with origin ySyncPluginKey; pending-sync tells it from a typed edit by the absent addToHistory meta.

ygo's OnTokenAuth gets only (room, token), so the HTTP-time admission is recorded per (room, schema_version) and answered to the token; the 15 s re-check closes a revoked socket with 1012 through a wrapped hijacked conn.

A take-over subscribes to a fresh deliver subject before it recreates the durable, so a previous-build standby never sees it unbound; nats-server refuses a DeliverSubject update while the old subject has interest, so it is delete and create.
The previous release (v18.4.0) exits without acking the message in its handler; the harness tolerates exactly that one redelivery and fails any duplicate whose first handling is this build's.
deviations: Plan departures 1-3 as approved (unknown elements refused safely; text-only meaning search on an inactive embedder identity; protections bind from the release after this one).
D3 refuses only newly added not-yet-creatable elements, so a document a newer build wrote stays editable.
D7: a version write whose approved version holds newer content answers 409 DOC_NEWER_CONTENT on every write path, not only settlement, so no path drops the carry.
Owning bus clients also re-read the deployed subjects every 60 s.
Previous release for CI is now legion-envoy-v18.4.0; against v18.1.0 the block graph's 'block' refs rows are deleted by v18.1.0 (no unknown-kind guard), history not fixable here.
The previous build cannot serve on a held socket (no DISPATCH_LISTEN_FD), so the harnesses let it bind its own port (small port race in tests only).
